app_fee.value: The Graduate School charges $60 to degree-seeking applicants; the page lists no separate international fee.

fee_waiver.value: The application-fee exemption covers only people with a GRE or GMAT fee reduction or waiver, McNair Scholars and some Illinois veterans; no international waiver is listed.
fee_waiver.quote: Individuals who received a GRE or GMAT fee reduction or fee waiver

gre_general.value: The Graduate School leaves the GRE to each program, so check the program record.
gre_general.quote: The graduate program you're applying to may require you to submit an unofficial copy of your GRE, GMAT, MAT or other entrance exam scores

toefl_min.value: The Graduate School requires a TOEFL score of at least 80 for graduate admission.

ielts_min.value: The Graduate School accepts an IELTS score of 6.5 as one of its graduate minimums.

english_waiver.value: India is not on NIU's list of countries whose degrees exempt applicants from TOEFL or IELTS, so an Indian degree does not waive the test.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL or IELTS scores not required of students who received or will receive a university degree in one of the following countries

notes: Sources: NIU Graduate School pages (application materials, apply-now), the NIU list of doctoral programs and the department pages for each program. The Graduate School's English-exempt country list was checked for India (not listed). Graduate catalog pages on catalog.niu.edu and go.niu.edu returned no content (HTTP 202), so catalog-only rules were not used.
